scope: N5 numerical display continuity and N6 isolated worker / synthetic session contracts

source_age.exact_equality: compare stored numeric value, no rounding or epsilon snap
source_age.reset: return original immutable GLB, texture and coefficients; never substitute SAM same-age output

sam.direct_target_condition: exact integer only, including integer-valued JSON numbers
sam.fractional_source_age: preserve; original reset allowed; no fractional-source SAM geometry differences
sam.input: existing FFHQ-aligned 256x256 RGB PNG, bounded bytes over local stdio
sam.output: 1024x1024 generated 2D PNG, not a UV atlas
sam.loading_status: research_loaded after actual load and finite forward self-test, never production ready
sam.asset_policy: existing hash-bound local research checkpoint only; no download or training

display_experiment.anchors: strictly increasing unique ages; include exact source age when a true source asset is available
display_experiment.interpolation: piecewise linear in age, reject extrapolation
display_experiment.alpha: interpolate premultiplied linear RGB and alpha; both-unknown pixels remain zero
display_experiment.source_geometry: unchanged at all ages for current static fallback
display_experiment.render_modes: floating compositing experiment and existing uint8 MASK/0.5 assets evaluated separately
measurements: support gain/loss/XOR and Jaccard per adjacent registered target pair
float alpha and black/white composite differences at decreasing epsilon
uint8 quantization and MASK/0.5 visible-pixel flips
exact original-object reset in synthetic source contexts
registered real source reset marked unavailable without an original source atlas
display_experiment.previous_exposure: All N4 atlases are development observations. Support XOR/Jaccard for 27 pairs was inspected before this protocol; new epsilon/quantization measurements are frozen separately before running.

sessions.production_route: existing /api/aging continues MODEL_NOT_READY; no environment or test bypass in production factory
sessions.source_context: immutable original RGB, aligned PNG, serialized fit/alignment, original GLB/PNG, source-age provenance and original shape
sessions.ttl: fixed from source publication; reads and generated results never extend it
sessions.budget: all serialized source and result bytes plus float64 coefficient payloads; Python object overhead is additional
sessions.expiry: periodic sweep required for idle deletion; expired in-flight contexts remain charged and inaccessible to new requests until completion
sessions.result_cache: exact target age within immutable source session; all results inherit source expiry
sessions.late_work: timeouts/disconnects do not publish results or release admission/context leases before actual processing completion
sessions.close: deny new work, drain or terminate only owned child then await actual exit; release payload leases and device admission afterwards
sessions.persistence: production context library and worker exchange no private image files; research probe output files are explicit offline artifacts

validation.frontend: actual client/viewer against synthetic loopback fixture in Chrome and Edge; label synthetic
validation.worker: one persistent real local SAM process, forward self-test and two integer requests, hash/timing/memory/PID/exit evidence
